Taramisu is a university project at Technische Hochschule Ingolstadt. Its goal
is a web prototype for structured, traceable Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment
(TARA), taking ISO/SAE 21434:2021 into account as required by the project brief.

:::info Initial documentation
The application is being developed. The pages below describe the intended scope
and provide a structure for verified user instructions. They do not claim that
the planned features are already available or that conformity has been demonstrated.
:::

## Intended scope

The project brief calls for an English user interface, project sharing with
permissions, and import/export of TARA projects. German language support,
guidance during the assessment, and more consistent assessments are desired.
An LLM integration is optional. Availability will be recorded in the release notes.
